title: Building tweaks
lines: In The Works, belt, splitter, joiner and tunnel take the first four toolbar slots, keys 1 to 4. Any other tool you unlock goes at the end.
A tunnel takes two clicks or taps: where it goes in, then where it comes up. The piece whose card is open is marked in the yard with gold corners.

more.head: Also
points: Click where a tunnel goes in a second time and it comes up at the nearest free tile, as one click did.
On a phone, tap where the tunnel goes in, tap where it comes up, then Build.
Both ends of a tunnel are marked when its card is open. When the Trouble list takes you to a piece, the corners close in on it.
On a phone, the Trouble list takes you to the piece and marks it without opening its card over it. Tap the piece for its card.
